overall_status_zh: 这些任务没有全部完成。展示层、全屏图和静态 PNG 同步基本完成；证据层和可采信覆盖率仍需继续补强。
overall_status_en: The requested work is not fully complete. Presentation, full-screen graph runtime, and static PNG sync are mostly implemented; evidence strength and accepted coverage still need improvement.

issue_register.purpose_zh: 把未完成项转换为可执行补证据任务，包含优先级、待处理队列、下一步动作和阻断风险。
issue_register.purpose_en: Converts unresolved items into actionable evidence-closure tasks with priority, queue files, next action, and blocking risk.

items.implemented_zh: 已把 GHG Protocol 拆成 19 个细分系列/标准/指南/项目节点，并在图2、GHG 全屏图和标准角色族图中展示。
items.remaining_zh: 显式证据仍不足：231 家 GHG 相关企业中只有 137 家显式命中具体系列；当前只有 267 条 accepted 细分边，454 条 12 类白名单内企业-系列边仍为 effective review；另有 19 条白名单外 GHG 衍生/泛化引用已隔离复核。其中 P1 样本缺少命名系列 169 条、P2 低证据上下文 285 条。不能把上下文映射当成强证据。
items.implemented_en: GHG Protocol has been split into fine-series standard, guidance, project-protocol, and program nodes and is shown in Figure 2, the GHG full-screen graph, and the standard role-family graph; current counts are injected from reporting_views.json and the authoritative exports.
items.remaining_en: Explicit evidence remains insufficient: 137/231 GHG-related companies explicitly cite concrete series; only 267 fine-series edges are accepted, and 454 core-whitelist company-series edges remain effective review rows, and 19 out-of-whitelist GHG-derived/generic references are isolated for separate review. The open queue includes 169 P1 named-series-missing rows and 285 P2 low-evidence contextual rows. Contextual mappings must not be treated as strong evidence.

items.status_zh: 结构已完成，证据质量仍需持续提升
items.implemented_zh: 标准角色图包含 27 个标准节点、331 家企业、1241 条标准-企业关系；全屏图已按标准/行业颜色展示。
items.remaining_zh: 关系结构已存在，但每条边的 PDF 页码、snippet 完整度和强弱证据等级仍需继续复核。
items.status_en: Structure complete, evidence quality still needs improvement
items.implemented_en: The standard role graph contains the current reporting_views.json standard nodes, companies, and standard-company relationships; the full-screen graph colors standards and industries distinctly.
items.remaining_en: The relationship structure exists, but each edge still needs stronger page-level traceability, snippet completeness, and evidence-strength review.

items.implemented_zh: 已生成企业总排放强证据排行和静态 PNG；当前有 85 家企业可计算可用总量。
items.remaining_zh: 只有 21 家满足完整 Scope 1 + 选定 Scope 2 + Scope 3 强证据可比排行；64 家 partial 总量不能混成完整排行。Scope 1、Scope 2 方法/数值和 Scope 3 缺口仍需继续回到页级证据闭环。
items.implemented_en: A strong-evidence total-emissions ranking and static PNG have been generated; 85 companies currently have available total-emissions values.
items.remaining_en: Only 21 companies meet the complete Scope 1 + selected Scope 2 + Scope 3 strong-evidence comparable-ranking gate. The 64 partial totals must not be mixed into the complete ranking, and Scope 1, Scope 2 value/method, and Scope 3 gaps remain open.

items.implemented_zh: 50 个 full-graph HTML 已统一为内嵌 JSON；4 个 GHG/Standard 角色族页使用 reporting_views 同源裁剪 JSON，46 个旧 generic 页使用严格版本化 JSON 和共享 generic_full_graph.js。静态 fallback 和旧 inline runtime 已移除。
items.remaining_zh: 两个旧 principle 角色族页本身无可绘制节点，当前进入可见空数据状态；这属于数据空缺，不是运行时 fallback。
items.implemented_en: All 50 full-graph HTML pages now use embedded JSON. The 4 GHG/Standard role-family pages embed same-source reporting_views graph subsets, while 46 legacy generic pages use strict versioned JSON plus shared generic_full_graph.js. Static fallback and old inline runtime have been removed.
items.remaining_en: Two legacy principle role-family pages have no drawable nodes and now enter a visible empty-data state. This is a data gap, not a runtime fallback.

items.status_zh: 口径已实现，源文引用仍需复核
items.implemented_zh: 页面和图谱已明确：只有 GHG Protocol 语境使用 Scope 1/2/3；非 GHG 标准默认使用直接/间接排放口径。非 GHG 标准自身名称/角色/原则中的 Scope 术语误用为 0 条。
items.remaining_zh: 仍有 74 条源文引用含 Scope 词，需要确认它们只作为原文证据展示，而没有被提升为非 GHG 标准自身术语。
items.status_en: Policy implemented, source quotations still need review
items.implemented_en: Pages and graphs now state that Scope 1/2/3 terminology applies only under GHG Protocol context; non-GHG standards default to direct/indirect emissions wording. Non-GHG standard name/role/principle Scope-term misuse is currently zero.
items.remaining_en: Seventy-four source quotations still contain Scope wording and need review to confirm that they are quoted source context only, not non-GHG standard terminology.

items.status_zh: 展示完成，证据核验未完成
items.implemented_zh: 图6 已有 9 类技术路径、流程图、标准对齐、细分技术方向、时间信号和成本信号，并生成中英文静态 PNG。另有独立页级项目证据层：77 条有效项目/措施证据，覆盖 51 家企业，其中 12 条含成本/投资证据，67 条含减排效果证据。
items.remaining_zh: 独立项目证据层可作为页级项目/措施强证据使用，invalid 项目证据队列为 0 条。但旧的 303 条技术-企业关系仍是 disclosure keyword signal，不是已核证项目成本、实施进度或减排量；公司级证据、时间趋势和成本/投资复核队列仍需继续处理。
items.implemented_en: Figure 6 now shows 9 technology paths with flow, standards alignment, subtypes, timeline signals, cost signals, and bilingual static PNGs. A separate page-level project-evidence layer contains 77 valid project/measure records across 51 companies, including 12 cost/investment records and 67 abatement-effect records. A project-upgrade queue now covers 303 disclosure-signal edges with priority counts {'P1': 227, 'P2': 76}.
items.remaining_en: The separate project-evidence layer can be used as page-level project/measure evidence, with 0 invalid project-evidence rows. However, the legacy 303 technology-company rows remain disclosure keyword signals, not verified project cost, implementation progress, or abatement values. The project-upgrade queue marks missing project/measure name, page/source binding, implementation stage, timeline, cost/investment, and abatement-effect fields; no row allows automatic promotion.

items.status_zh: 展示完成，计算权重证据不足
items.implemented_zh: 初级/次级气泡图已生成；306 家进入来源结构数据，161 家有可显示初级/次级比例。
items.remaining_zh: 只有 13 家来自原文明示 primary data 百分比，其余主要是 method_rows 来源结构推断，不等同已审定计算权重。来源类别补回 145 条、unknown 占比复核 143 条、计算权重核验 161 条仍待处理。
items.implemented_en: The primary/secondary bubble chart exists; 306 companies enter the source-mix data and 161 companies have displayable primary/secondary ratios.
items.remaining_en: Only 13 companies use explicitly reported primary-data percentages. Most remaining ratios are method_rows source-mix inference and are not audited calculation weights.

items.implemented_zh: 排放排行、图2、图6、初级/次级气泡图均有中英文静态 PNG；manifest 记录 reporting_views 源 hash 和每张 PNG hash，GitHub 页面和汇报图可同源校验。
items.remaining_zh: 后续只要 reporting_views.json 更新，就必须重跑 sync_reporting_static_figures.py。
items.implemented_en: The emissions ranking, Figure 2, Figure 6, and primary/secondary bubble chart all have bilingual static PNGs. The manifest records the reporting_views source hash and each PNG hash.
items.remaining_en: Whenever reporting_views.json changes, sync_reporting_static_figures.py must be rerun.

next_priority_order: P0: 继续把 GHG contextual/review 边回到 PDF 页级证据，能显式命名具体系列的升级，不能命名的降级或删除。
P0: 补完整排放排行的 Scope 1 / Scope 2 方法与数值 / Scope 3 缺口，避免 partial 总量误当完整排行。
P1: 技术路径从关键词信号升级到公司级项目证据、时间节点和成本/投资证据。
P1: 初级/次级数据比例从来源结构推断升级到真实计算权重证据。
P2: 持续复核非 GHG 标准源文引用中的 Scope 词，只保留为引用语境，不提升为非 GHG 标准术语。
next_priority_order_en: P0: Return GHG contextual/review edges to page-level PDF evidence; upgrade only explicitly named fine-series citations, and demote or remove weak contextual edges.
P0: Close emissions-ranking gaps for Scope 1, Scope 2 method/value, and Scope 3 so partial totals are not treated as complete comparable rankings.
P1: Upgrade technology paths from keyword signals to company-level project evidence, timeline milestones, and cost/investment evidence.
P1: Upgrade primary/secondary data ratios from source-mix inference to true calculation-weight evidence or explicitly reported primary-data percentages.
P2: Continue reviewing Scope wording in non-GHG standard source quotations so it remains source context and is not promoted into non-GHG standard terminology.

requirement_completion_matrix.purpose_zh: 把原始五大需求逐条映射为完成状态、证据文件、未闭环队列和是否可声明完成。
requirement_completion_matrix.purpose_en: Maps the original requirements to completion status, proof files, unresolved queues, and whether completion can be claimed.

p0_closure_batches.title_zh: GHG Protocol 细分系列 P0 页级证据闭环批次
p0_closure_batches.title_en: GHG Protocol fine-series P0 page-level evidence closure batch
p0_closure_batches.purpose_zh: 把 contextual / overmapped GHG 系列边按公司、报告和页码分组；只作为复核入口，不自动提升采信关系。
p0_closure_batches.purpose_en: Groups contextual and overmapped GHG series edges by company, report, and page; review entry only, not an automatic promotion.

p0_closure_batches.title_zh: 企业总排放排行 P0 Scope 缺口闭环批次
p0_closure_batches.title_en: Company total-emissions ranking P0 Scope-gap closure batch
p0_closure_batches.purpose_zh: 把 Scope 1 / Scope 2 / Scope 3 缺口按公司和页级证据分组；确认前不得并入完整可比排行。
p0_closure_batches.purpose_en: Groups Scope 1 / Scope 2 / Scope 3 gaps by company and page-level evidence; keep out of the complete comparable ranking until confirmed.

authoritative_exports.title_zh: GHG 已采信细分标准-企业关系
authoritative_exports.purpose_zh: 仅包含原文明确命名具体 GHG Protocol 细分系列的关系，可作为当前标准-企业结论表。
authoritative_exports.purpose_en: Contains only source-explicit GHG Protocol fine-series relationships and can be used as the current standard-company conclusion table.

authoritative_exports.title_zh: GHG 待复核细分标准-企业关系
authoritative_exports.purpose_zh: 包含上下文、泛化和疑似过度映射关系，不得作为已采信结论。
authoritative_exports.purpose_en: Contains contextual, generic, and possible overmapped relationships; not accepted conclusions.

authoritative_exports.title_zh: 完整可比企业总排放排行
authoritative_exports.purpose_zh: 仅包含 Scope 1 + 选定 Scope 2 + Scope 3 均通过强证据门禁的企业。
authoritative_exports.purpose_en: Contains only companies with complete Scope 1 + selected Scope 2 + Scope 3 strong-evidence totals.

authoritative_exports.title_zh: 部分总排放排行复核表
authoritative_exports.purpose_zh: 包含缺 Scope 或口径未闭环的部分总量，不得混入完整可比排行。
authoritative_exports.purpose_en: Contains partial totals with missing scope or open method issues; excluded from the complete comparable ranking.

authoritative_exports.title_zh: 技术路径披露信号复核表
authoritative_exports.purpose_zh: 包含公司-技术族关键词/披露信号；未经公司级验证前，不得作为技术采用、减排量、时间线或成本结论。
authoritative_exports.purpose_en: Contains company-technology disclosure signals; not verified technology adoption, abatement, timeline, or cost conclusions before company-level validation.

authoritative_exports.title_zh: 初级数据明示百分比表
authoritative_exports.purpose_zh: 包含原文明示 primary data 百分比的企业；用于审计级计算权重前仍需验证。
authoritative_exports.purpose_en: Contains companies with explicitly reported primary-data percentages; calculation-weight validation is still required before audit-grade use.

authoritative_exports.title_zh: 初级/次级来源结构推断复核表
authoritative_exports.purpose_zh: 包含方法行来源结构推断或非明示比例；不得作为已审定 primary data 计算权重。
authoritative_exports.purpose_en: Contains method-row source-mix inference or non-explicit ratios; not audited primary-data calculation weights.

emissions_gap_candidate_diagnostics.title_zh: 排放排行缺口 expanded_evidence 候选诊断
emissions_gap_candidate_diagnostics.title_en: Emissions-ranking gap candidate diagnostics from expanded_evidence
emissions_gap_candidate_diagnostics.purpose_zh: 列出已在 expanded_evidence 中出现、但尚未通过强证据门禁的缺口 Scope 行；只作为复核入口，不自动提升采信。
emissions_gap_candidate_diagnostics.purpose_en: Lists missing-scope rows already present in expanded_evidence but not yet passing the strong-evidence gate; review entry only, no automatic promotion.

emissions_p0_gap_review_packet.title_zh: 排放排行 P0 缺口人工复核包
emissions_p0_gap_review_packet.title_en: Emissions-ranking P0 gap manual review packet
emissions_p0_gap_review_packet.purpose_zh: 把 P0 候选拆成抽取假阴性、强候选冲突和仍需页级复核三类；所有行均禁止自动提升。
emissions_p0_gap_review_packet.purpose_en: Splits P0 candidates into extraction false-negative checks, conflicting strong candidates, and page-level rechecks, and generates a near-complete partial-company queue. All rows explicitly forbid automatic promotion.
